computed_stats: Ingest queues receive approximately 40,000 shipment records daily. The system processes these through a normalization stage, a rules engine, and a notification fan-out layer.
judgements: The platform's fail-fast behavior ensures actionable error output over internal retry loops. Every statistic in the artifact shows its derivation: raw inputs, arithmetic applied, and result, presented so a reviewer can repeat the computation with a calculator and obtain the same figure.
consistency_checks: No statement anywhere may conflict with any numeric table in the same artifact. Each section must stand alone: a reader who jumps directly to any one section must be able to act on it without reading the others.
verdict: The platform's architecture, including its six-week release train and conventional commits, ensures stability and reliability.
